questions.q: What date is celebrated as National Maritime Day in India?
questions.explain: 📅 National Maritime Day is observed on April 5 every year to recognize the maritime sector's importance. It's a day to commemorate India's rich maritime history! 🌊

questions.q: What significant ship embarked on its maiden voyage on April 5, 1919, marking a turning point in India's maritime trade?
questions.explain: 🚢 The SS Loyalty set sail on its maiden voyage from Mumbai to London, symbolizing India's emerging independence in maritime trade. 🌍 An important chapter in India's shipping history! 📚

questions.q: What is the main objective of the Namo Drone Didi Yojana?
options: To empower women-led Self-Help Groups by training them as drone pilots
To distribute free drones to all farmers in Karnataka
To reduce the use of technology in agriculture
To eliminate self-help groups in rural areas
questions.explain: 🚀 The Namo Drone Didi Yojana aims to empower women by training SHGs as drone pilots. This initiative focuses on modern technology in agriculture, enhancing efficiency in farming! 🌾💪

questions.q: What is the primary mandate of the Commission for Air Quality Management (CAQM)?
options: To ensure better coordination and resolution of air pollution issues
To coordinate solely with the Delhi government
To manage air quality only in rural areas
questions.explain: 🌍 The CAQM focuses on tackling air pollution's challenges effectively! Their role is vital for improving the AQI in congested regions like Delhi-NCR. Remember: Coordination = Better Air! 🌬️💪
